Increased Size |sandbox = Yes |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Bloated.png|Bloated}} }} ==Description== '''Bloated''' is a status effect that for most of its uses, doubles an enemy's health. ==Mechanics== '''Bloated''' enemies will have their health be increased by 100% in most circumstances, though rarely the buff will be a different percentage. This only affects their regular health, [[Shield Health]] is not increased. Similarly, all enemies in the [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] challenge map spawn with the '''Bloated''' attribute due to the [[Juggernaut (Modifier)|Juggernaut]] modifier, although it should be noted that some enemies' health values are altered. Enemies can receive '''Bloated''', even if they did not spawn with it if they are hit by a gift explosion created by the [[Fallen Jester]]'s ''Devious Tricks'' ability and [[Hex Weaver]]'s ''Spooky Tricks'' ability. The [[Protein Shake]] consumable also applies '''Bloated''' to the next three enemies sent by a player. In the [[Null & Void Event]], if the [[Death]] curse was selected, all enemies would spawn with '''Bloated'''. ==Tower & Unit List== Although no known use on towers for this attribute exists, the following towers used to have '''Bloated''': *[[Golden Snowballer]] ==Update History== *'''3 May 2024''' - [[v1.20.0]] **'''Bloated''' added. **{{Bug}} Units deal damage at a really fast rate while not being damaged themselves when a '''Bloated''' enemy has less than half health. **{{Bug}} '''Bloated''' enemies do not generate cash when damaged in legacy modes if the enemy has less than half health. **{{Bug}} '''Bloated''' does not increase the health of enemies if they had their health altered by modifiers. **{{Bug}} '''Bloated''' enemies will sometimes show incorrect max health after scalin. *'''23 June 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.1]] **{{Bugfix}} Unit now deal damage to '''Bloated''' enemies correctly. **{{Bugfix}} Health increased from '''Bloated''' now generates cash. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **'''Bloated''' now makes enemies bigger by anywhere between 15% and 25% through [[Scale]]. *'''9 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.5]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Bloated''' now increases health of enemies that had their health altered by modifiers. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Bloated''' size increased from anywhere between 15% and 25% to 50%. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Enemies now show correct max health after '''Bloated''' scales it. {{AttributeNavBox}}
